style: Flat vector game icon in the chess.com illustration style: chunky rounded friendly forms, bold saturated colour, soft two-tone cel shading with exactly one lit plane and one shadow plane per surface, a small white highlight glint where light hits, and a slight three-quarter top-down view so the object shows a top face and a side face. Premium and playful, like a mobile game reward icon. BANNED: outlines, strokes, black contour lines, gradients, textures, noise, grain, drop shadows, glows, sparkles, confetti, text, letters, numbers, chess pieces, people, faces, hands, background scenery. The colour magenta #FF00FF and any pink or purple must NEVER appear inside the subject.
framing: Background: one uniform flat #FF00FF magenta, edge to edge, and it is the ONLY thing behind the subject. Square canvas. One single object, centred, filling about 70 percent of the canvas width with an even margin on every side. Solid filled shapes only, never an outline drawing. Every detail at least one twenty-fourth of the canvas wide so the icon still reads at 40 pixels.
